notes.title: Major Bug Fix - Composite Colliders
notes.notes:
There's been a bigtime oopsies going on since we introduced Meat-Shaped Colliders. It's been brought to my attention through watching people play the game that sometimes meats will fall through the container or burst out the sides when playing with Meat-Shaped Colliders turned on.

I spent a lot of time trying to fix this, and finally came up with a new solution. So, everybody who has been playing with Meat-Shaped colliders will now be moved over to Composite Colliders which are still way more meat-shaped than circular, but not quite as good as Meat-Shaped. But, they do have the advantage of staying in the jar and not popping out the bottom.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Balance Changes
notes.notes:
Nobody seemed to really care for who was on top of the global leaderboard, so we made some changes that will inflate everybody's scores, as well as make it easier to play the game predictably without your meat flying out of the jar all wimbly bimbly.

Balance Changes

 Larger meats are now heavier meats, so they do a better job of staying in the jar and not pushing everything around
 When meats merge, they now award extra points equal to half of the Pepperoni Equivalent (PPE) value of the new meat.
 Merge streak milestones (G-G-G-Glizzy, Overglizzy, Glizzymanjaro) now each award 16 points when reached.


Other Changes

 To pump people up and make them excited, I animated the score a little bit. I didn't do a great job of it, but hopefully it gets some people juicing.

notes.title: Global Leaderboard Update
notes.notes: Alright, now that there are people playing that aren't my friends and never will be, I wanted to see how we all stack up. This update Cycles through the Friends Leaderboard and the Global Leaderboard so we can see which one of us has the most meat in our jar.

notes.title: Launch Day Patch
notes.notes:
I know I had been planning on April 15th, but then early this morning Steam allowed me to press the Release button, so I did. The temptation was overwhelming.

But then I realized I wasn't quite finished with everything I wanted to do so I had to put together this patch, which addresses some of it:

- Application Icon has been changed from the default unity icon
- Pressing escape in game now brings up a menu instead of assuming you want to quit the game.

Upcoming enhancements:
- Currently the leader board only shows your friends, soon it will be toggleable to see the global leaderboard

notes.title: Stats & Achievements Update
notes.notes:
Do you remember in the last update when I added an S & A (Stats and Achieves) button to the main menu? Do you also remember that it didn't do anything?

The S & A (Stats and Achieves) button now functions a little differently. It brings up your stats (no word on the achieves yet). Check them out. I think they're pretty neat. I have some plans for adding some additional stats before launch, but I wanted to get these out there and I wasted a lot of time wondering why my stats weren't saving when it turns out I was just... you know what? I don't need to explain myself to you.

Finally, for those of you that loved the functionality of the S & A (Stats and Achieves) button before this update, don't worry. The new Options button now does nothing. I'm sure you'll like it just as much.

notes.title: April 15th Release
notes.notes:
To celebrate the deadline for filing taxes in the United States, as well as the beginning of FPS Fest here on Steam, we have decided to release Hotdog Kitchen on April 15th.

Oh my god, I'm just now realizing "Hot dog" is two words. We might need to push this release. Oh man, why didn't anybody tell me? It's fine. I've decided it's a stylistic choice. Another crisis averted.
